name: Firststep Scout
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - Firststep Scout has +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Fast temporal scout stepping across numbered afterimages, light gear and a clear forward-moving silhouette.

name: Second Bell Adept
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - The first time each round your Sequence changes while remaining at 4 or 5, Second Bell Adept gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Bell-bearing time adept striking a suspended second bell while two nearby moments overlap around them.

name: Third Motion Engine
rules: Sequence Complete - Your next card this round costs 2 less, minimum 1.
art_target: Compact three-stage motion engine of rings, pistons and numbered arcs completing a precise temporal cycle.

name: Fourth Horizon
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - Fourth Horizon has +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Tall horizon-walker standing where four receding timelines converge, cloak and body stretched by perspective.

name: Zero Point Witness
rules: Sequence Complete - Restore 2 Health to yourself and 2 HP to Zero Point Witness.
art_target: Quiet witness at a luminous zero point, surrounded by frozen debris and a circular temporal void.

name: Interval Keeper
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - The first time each round your Sequence changes, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Interval keeper operating a measured clockwork instrument between two suspended moments, scholarly but practical.

name: Relay Walker
rules: Sequence Complete - Ready another friendly creature that has already acted this round. It may take one additional combat action this round.
art_target: Relay walker passing a glowing action-token between afterimages of allied fighters, movement chaining forward.

name: Fifth Vector
rules: Sequence Complete - Fifth Vector gains +3 STR this round. If it has not acted this round, it may immediately take one combat action.
art_target: Aggressive fifth-vector combatant formed from five directional lines, launching forward as the sequence completes.

name: Between Moments
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - Between Moments has Taunt and +0 STR / +2 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Heavy sentinel literally standing between two frozen moments, layered temporal plates creating a protective barrier.

name: Continuum Scribe
rules: Sequence Complete - Draw 2 cards, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Continuum scribe writing on looping strips of time-script while pages appear both before and after the pen.

name: Endline Predator
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - Endline Predator has +3 STR.
art_target: Predatory temporal beast stalking the final edge of a sequence, lean silhouette with receding afterimage jaws.

name: Ourostep Architect
rules: On play, Shift your Sequence 1 step in its current direction. High Sequence (4/5) - Once per round when your Sequence would Shift, you may keep it at its current number instead.
art_target: Ourostep architect shaping a circular walkway that folds back into itself, elegant impossible engineering rather than machinery clutter.

name: Frozen in Balance
signature_detail: Sequence 1 → 2 → 3 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 1 → 2 → 3 occurs during one round, activate. For your next 3 turns, Sequence cannot advance above 4; effects that would advance it while at 4 do not move it.
art_target: Abstract FLUX: sequence 1→2→3 locking into a frozen luminous 4, with 5 visibly blocked beyond it.

name: Borrowed Future
signature_detail: Sequence 2 → 3 → 4 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 2 → 3 → 4 occurs during one round, activate. Draw 2 cards, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Abstract FLUX: a future scene pulled backward through 2→3→4, cardlike fragments arriving before their cause.

name: Split Second
signature_detail: Sequence 3 → 4 → 5 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 3 → 4 → 5 occurs during one round, activate. All friendly creatures gain +2 STR this round.
art_target: Abstract FLUX: 3→4→5 snapping into a violent split-second surge across allied silhouettes.

name: Backstep Paradox
signature_detail: Sequence 5 → 4 → 3 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 5 → 4 → 3 occurs during one round, activate. Restore 2 HP to every friendly creature.
art_target: Abstract FLUX: 5→4→3 reversing through a cool restorative wave that passes over several wounded figures.

name: Impossible Return
signature_detail: Sequence 3 → 2 → 1 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 3 → 2 → 1 occurs during one round, activate. Draw 2 cards, then put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Abstract FLUX: 3→2→1 collapsing backward into its own origin, two card fragments returning to the loop.

name: Möbius Lock
signature_detail: Sequence 4 → 5 → 4 occurs during one round, activate
rules: FLUX 0 — If Sequence 4 → 5 → 4 occurs during one round, activate. Your printed High Sequence effects remain active until the end of your next round even if Sequence leaves 4/5. Draw 1 card.
art_target: Möbius-shaped time lock suspended over 4→5→4, impossible continuous ribbon holding high-sequence energy in place.

name: Out of Order
rules: When an enemy creature attacks, High Sequence (4/5) - That attacker gets -3 STR for this combat. If you are not at High Sequence, this Trap remains set.
art_target: Temporal trap causing an attacker to move out of order, body misaligned across three contradictory frames.

name: Last Before First
rules: When a friendly creature is destroyed, Shift your Sequence 1 step in its current direction. Sequence Complete - Draw 1 card.
art_target: A fallen ally becoming the final tick before a new first beat, sequence marker shifting as the body fades.

name: Opening Echo
rules: On play, Shift your Sequence 1 step in its current direction. Sequence Complete - If this play caused the completion, draw 1 card.
art_target: Small echo-creature entering through a repeating doorway, its first step generating another temporal step behind it.

name: Midpoint Warden
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - The first time each round a friendly creature would take damage, reduce that damage by 2.
art_target: Midpoint warden bracing beneath a clock-face midpoint, intercepting incoming force before it reaches an ally.

name: Triple Threader
rules: Sequence Complete - Draw 2 cards, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Three-thread temporal operator weaving three glowing timeline strands into one completed pattern.

name: Loop Hound
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - Loop Hound has +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP. Whenever your Sequence moves from 5 to 4, ready Loop Hound.
art_target: Loop hound sprinting through a circular 5→4 track, muscular animal silhouette repeated around the loop.

name: Seventh Step
rules: High Sequence (4/5) - The first Spell you play each round costs 2 less, minimum 1.
art_target: Seventh-step mystic standing beyond a five-step path, opening a shortcut that makes later spells visibly lighter.

name: The Infinite Interval
rules: High Sequence (4/5) — The Infinite Interval has +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP. Sequence Complete — Draw 2 cards; your next card this round costs 2 less, minimum 1. SKIP AHEAD — Perfect Acceleration: you may use Skip Ahead twice per round; each use still requires its discard. LOOP BACK — Closed Circuit: the first time each round your Sequence moves backward while at 4 or 5, all friendly creatures with a High Sequence effect gain +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP this round.
art_target: The Infinite Interval: monumental time entity spanning multiple moments at once, elegant humanoid/construct hybrid framed by endless numbered arcs.

name: Count to Three
rules: Shift your Sequence 1 step in its current direction. High Sequence (4/5) - Your next three cards this round each cost 1 less, minimum 1.
art_target: Spell scene of three measured steps accelerating a sequence, three cost-runes dimming in succession.

name: Repeat Measure
rules: Sequence Complete - Copy one other Sequence Complete effect you control that triggered from this completion. You may choose new legal targets.
art_target: One completed temporal effect reflected and replayed beside itself, targets splitting into two legal futures.

name: Beyond the Fifth
rules: Sequence Complete - Draw 2 cards. Your next card this round costs 3 less, minimum 1.
art_target: A figure crossing beyond the fifth marker into a bright impossible sixth space filled with drawn card fragments.

name: Missed Beat
rules: When an enemy creature attacks, Shift your Sequence 1 step in its current direction. High Sequence (4/5) - If your Sequence is 4 or 5 after the Shift, that attacker gets -3 STR for this combat.
art_target: Trap scene where an attack lands on a missing beat, sequence shifting sideways as the attacker loses force.
